meta.source: docs/bdsp_ignored_values.md (2105 trainer materials: battle 917, objects 222, field 966)
meta.tool: none yet: audit-fields does not cover Unity bundles; counts are materials unless stated

entries.hypothesis: map into extras.shading specular for all materials
entries.notes: 561 of 2105 mats are not (2.0, 10.0); power 10 x1536, 50 x246, up to 256; colour non-white on 428 mats ((0.7,0.8,1.0) x163 hair). Strongest: Poke Balls ob0201..ob0213 `ball` 7/40, tr0047_00 scarf 16/256, pc0002_18 metal 12.7/3. Risk high (balls/props matte vs game).

entries.hypothesis: emissive = colour x intensity masked by _uti R
entries.notes: 830 mats > 0; eyes 2-3 with colour (0.81,0.87,0.90); lamps/badges up to 12-16 (ob1004_00 light 12, tr0039_00 wear2 10 yellow, tr1055_00 lens 9.5). Colour alpha 0 on 682 / 1 on 235 battle mats (meaning unknown). On/Off time 0.2/0.4 on 16 mats suggests blinking.

Importer only scales down below 0.15, so a 0.92 mirror (tr1046_00 glass) and a 0.2 metal get the same boost. `_ReflectionBias` (blur mip) 0 x91, 0.77 x62, 3 x34, 4 x23, 5 x7; we use fixed roughness 0.2. Risk med-high.

51 of 64 also `_ALPHABLEND_ON` (BLEND). Pure cutout (opaque with holes in our output): tr0030_00 wear, tr1055_00/tr1056_00 wear/ski, tr1068_00, tr1072_00, tr1088_00 wear (`_Cutoff` 0.5). 32 have `_Cutoff` 0.

entries.where: Mesh m_Colors (vertex colour RGB grey + alpha)
entries.notes: Dropped. 186/189 battle meshes carry colours, 135 vary (grey RGB std up to 0.3; alpha varies on pc0001_10/_11/_14/_17). Looks like baked occlusion; alpha maybe a mask. Unknown shader use.

Black on all 220 eyes (rim off). `_RimPower` 8 x1548, 1.5 x226 (broad); `_RimScale` 0.5 x1210 up to 4.12; `_RimStrength` 8 x2020; `_RimBlendWeight` 0.3 x1311. `USE_RIM_MASK_TEX` only on tr1021 Body00.

entries.hypothesis: R emission mask, G gloss mask, B AO
entries.notes: A = 1 everywhere; B mean 0.91 dipping in creases (AO?); R sparse on eyes (glint; R max > 0.5 in 126/197 textures whose material has emission) = emission mask?; G sparse on cloth/hats/hair = specular/gloss mask? Guesses from statistics only.
We use depth-writing BLEND for all; 715 `_ALPHABLEND_ON` mats use `_Mode 0` (opaque queue). No additive. Draw-order artefacts on glasses/shadow planes possible.
`_AnisLevelV` 11.12 only on tr0047_00 scarf; `_AnisotropicLightingEnable` 0 everywhere it exists.
`_MaskShadowExponential` 4 x2083, 16 x4. `_SubsurfaceBlendWeight` < 1 on 5 mats; `_SubsurfaceAdditionalColor` non-black on 12.
0.5 grey on ob2000_00 box/box_icon; gold (0.67,0.55,0.19) on tr2009/fc2009/fc2015/fc2023 metal. Intensity 0.9 x16, 0.95 x8, 1.1 x3.
Identical on all 346 mats that have it: a fixed battle fill light. Not modelled.
Not in the material (shader state; shader bundle cab-1dc8... missing from the rip). Only `_CullMode 2` on the 8 Pokemon-shader mats. double_sided never set.
